name: Last Dawn
desc:
*The original game is permanently taken down; If you lost your data, please report it in the Community Server to attempt recovery.
[TAKE NOTE, PLEASE USE MOUSE AND KEYBOARD FOR CONSOLE. CONSOLE SUPPORT ISN’T FULLY FUNCTIONAL YET..]

Stand your ground against the undead in the American Civil War.
A war between brothers, now fought for survival.

Inspired by Guts & Blackpowder.
Currently in active development; bugs & shutdowns are to be expected

Instrument tracks are bought from Civil War Instruments.
Credits to NBC51 and SerMaine for providing some of the in-game assets.
Clothing in-game is made by Semirechicus, his clothing are available here:
https://www.roblox.com/communities/33007632/Uniforms-of-the-Civil-War#!/store

In-game rules:
1. Inappropriate language or behavior is forbidden.
3. Exploiting of any kind will result in permanent ban.
3. Abusing glitches or bugs is strictly prohibited.
4. Follow Roblox’s TOS at all times.
